attBesluta.text: Clé qui fait le travail. Attention toutefois: si vous comptez l'utiliser pour le serrage des raccords frigorifiques, vérifiez qu'elle permet bien d'atteindre le couple de serrage préconisé par le constructeur. Pour ma part, j'ai dû improviser pour obtenir le couple minimal requis sur un raccord en 1/4".

I’ve been using this chain in my shop for 5 months and it has been a back saver…

I was in need of a proper shop throne when I came across this gem. Some assembly required? Not really! Simple assembly, construction feels strong, and its actually comfortable, vevor nailed it! Get you one!
Nice for the price, seat could be a bit bigger and more padding

This is a well built piece of equipment. The chair is sturdy and easy to use. I use it behind the pulpit as I need to get off my feet at times. Because of the adjustable height it would work well behind any counter that is sits at least 4 inches higher than your average desktop.

Solid chair. It's been working great, was easy to put together. Unfortunately it was taller than I liked. But that's not the fault of the chair, just my lack of measuring what I currently had. Fortunately, I was able to cut the legs shorter and 3d print some feet for the tubes of the legs to bring it to a height that works for me.

Très satisfait de cet achat, le tabouret est solide et de bonne qualité, je recommande vivement l’achat de ce tabouret pour mettre dans votre atelier ou votre garage, le dossier est ajustable en profondeur ce qui le rends très pratique.

Le tabouret est bien fait, l’assise est ferme mais confortable, attention a ne pas se tromper dans la longueur des vis car la notice n’est pas très explicative. Je l’utilise dans un atelier d’usinage lorsque je programme mes machines car le pupitre est très haut et la hauteur de l’assise me monte a la bonne hauteur.
The chair is ok. Easy to assemble. The seat is a bit small so it is not real comfortable. Other than that it seems fine.

What to say! WOW! It was special! First, the iron looks very good, the construction is very efficient, the air flow very good, even if in the begining there is a bit of smoke, dont worry, it will be better when everything started. I tested it, I love cooking systems, collect it, I am proud to say, I love this one! It is excellent! Thinking to buy another one, why? dont know, just in case.
Not foldable, but compact enough for transport in a car.
The carbon steel housing is extremely robust. No problems even under intense heat.

Amazing station for any business front of house. The setup is easy, clear, and not heavy, making it simple to move and use as needed. The clips are fully operational and easy for anyone on the team to use without confusion. It creates a clean, organized, and professional look while still being very functional. Highly recommend for any business looking for a simple and effective front-of-house setup.
No noise at normal speed. Stable lock system. Tested with 40 kg load until now.

Handy tool to have if you are under a dash board alot. Saved my back and me from sleepless nights of pain. I like that it's adjustable. The quality of the board and vinyl could use improvement. I added about 12 extra staples to ensure I don't prematurely rip the vinyl out of the board. The metal leg/foot seems to be solid. Overall, I am happy with the purchase.

I will point out that on one occasion this year, while opening an loft hatch, I got grit in my eye (should have worn safety specs) and this kit was invaluable to me.
